title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: accounting skills in Excel and Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Cowork plugin controls and revised usage-based licensing are supported. One minor correction is needed because the checklist asks users to enable the optional audit trail, but the controls table does not cover that setting.

claims.where: What's changing: relationship between roadmap and plugin
claims.claim: The roadmap record does not name the Accounting for Cowork plugin.
claims.quote: Searched: Accounting for Cowork, plugin and Frontier in the full supplied roadmap description; none is named. The record says only 'New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork'.

claims.claim: The Learn pages found do not document the built-in Excel accounting skills' behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Excel accounting reconciliation journal-entry skills admin enable disable default rollout. Read Available plugins for Copilot Cowork and Overview of Copilot skills for Excel; the latter covers custom skills, not built-in accounting skills.

claims.claim: Microsoft says Copilot does not provide accounting, tax, audit or financial advice.
claims.quote: Copilot doesn't provide accounting, tax, audit, or financial advice or professional determinations

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Cost and licensing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft requires review and verification of output against source records before entries are posted.
claims.quote: Review and verify all output, including calculations, account mappings, and tax treatments, against source records and applicable accounting standards, tax laws, and your organization's policies before you rely on it, post entries to a system of record

claims.claim: The plugin does not replace an organisation's internal controls, review or approval processes.
claims.quote: Accounting for Cowork doesn't replace your organization's internal controls, review, or approval processes.

claims.claim: Block prevents users in the tenant from accessing the plugin, subject to the stated existing-conversation exception.
claims.quote: Select **Block**: No users in your tenant can access the plugin.

claims.claim: The documented row governs the Cowork plugin, not the built-in Excel accounting skills.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Cowork supports plugins that add skills and connectors to extend what Cowork can do.

claims.where: summary; Governance controls: Excel control gap; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No control specifically for the built-in Excel accounting skills was found in the Learn pages searched.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Excel accounting skills Microsoft Graph PowerShell policy control; Copilot Excel accounting reconciliation journal-entry skills admin enable disable default rollout. Read Excel skills overview and Cowork plugin management; neither documents this control.

claims.claim: Cowork plugin activity appears in Microsoft Purview audit logs under Copilot activities.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics for the Excel accounting skills are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Excel accounting reconciliation journal-entry skills admin enable disable default rollout. Read the roadmap and Excel skills overview; neither describes built-in accounting rollout mechanics. The overview's channel restrictions apply to custom skills.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, combining Microsoft 365 Copilot entitlement with metered Cowork consumption.
claims.quote: Your Microsoft 365 Copilot Business license includes core Copilot capabilities, such as chat and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps. Certain advanced experiences, including Copilot Cowork and other long-running, autonomous agentic capabilities, use Copilot credits and are billed based on actual usage.

claims.claim: Variable cost correctly reflects metered Cowork consumption in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Current eligible usage-based experiences that use Copilot credits include Copilot Cowork, Code, Autopilot, the Work IQ APIs, and other long-running, autonomous agentic capabilities.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout, audit-trail bullet; Governance controls
claims.claim: The rollout checklist asks pilot users to switch on the audit trail without a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'ask them to switch it on for entries and reconciliations.' The sole table row governs 'Whether the Accounting for Cowork plugin is blocked or available to users or groups', not the audit trail.
claims.fix: Remove 'and ask them to switch it on for entries and reconciliations' from the At rollout bullet, leaving: 'Tell pilot users that the audit trail is a choice they make when invoking a capability.'
